name: static-content-site
description: Static, Markdown-driven website. Content lives in content/*.md and builds to flat HTML; a selectable strategy handles contact forms and mail.

questions.prompt: How should contact forms and mail be handled? Pick one: static-mail-gateway (posts to an external form service, works on static-only hosts), phpmailer-endpoint (self-hosted PHP + SMTP, needs a PHP host), or headless-wp-forms (submits to Fluent Forms via wp-fluent-forms-proxy). Pick none to ship a mailto: link only.

rules.message: Pages are SCM-compatible content/*.md (front matter + Markdown; no raw HTML or task lists), templates are plain JS in templates/, and `npm run build` renders dist/. `content-schema.json` documents the type-checked frontmatter contract; `npm run build` warns compatibly and `npm run validate:content` is the strict gate. SCM onboarding: contentDir=content, buildCommand=npm run build, buildDir=dist.
phpmailer-endpoint needs a PHP-capable host for /mail/. On static-only hosting (CDN, GitHub Pages) use static-mail-gateway or headless-wp-forms instead.
